name: Cape Verde
summary: A blue field with white and red stripes below the centre and a ring of ten yellow stars toward the hoist. Adopted in 1992, it replaced a Pan-African flag linked to the former ruling party.
origin: From independence in 1975, Cape Verde used a flag similar to Guinea-Bissau's, reflecting the shared liberation movement PAIGC. After the first multi-party elections in 1991, a new flag was adopted on 22 September 1992.

colors.name: Red
colors.meaning: Effort and the road to building the nation.

symbols.name: Ten stars
symbols.description: Ten yellow stars in a circle.
symbols.meaning: The ten main islands of the archipelago.

history.label: PAIGC-style flag
history.note: Red hoist band with an emblem, yellow and green.

facts: Its ring of stars echoes the flag of the European Union.
The stripes are often read as the road toward building the nation.
Cape Verde's ten islands include nine inhabited ones.
clues: Blue with white and red stripes and a ring of ten yellow stars.
Its stars stand for ten islands.
It replaced a flag shared in style with a mainland neighbour.
